name: Southwest Ground Turkey and Cauliflower Rice Skillet
unmapped: sriracha (in optional sriracha mayo; board has hot-sauce/chili-garlic-sauce but not sriracha specifically)
why: Verified published nutrition 476 cal / 33g protein / 15g carbs per serving - dead center of the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band with a high protein-to-calorie ratio. Structurally low-carb: ground turkey + olive oil + non-starchy veg served over cauliflower rice, no rice/pasta/potato/bean base. Pure skillet (brown, season, simmer), weigh-and-divide scalable to 14, all core ingredients on the Omaha board. Distinct from existing green-chile / calabacitas turkey skillets. Source is 3 servings; scale ~4.7x for 14.
